system.description: When you hit a target with a firearm attack, you can choose to reduce the damage by 1 point but hit the target in a precise spot. Some of the possible effects include (but are not limited to) the following: Shoot an object out of someone's hand. Shoot the target's leg, wing, or other limb they use to move, reducing their maximum movement speed to immediate for a few days or until they receive expert medical care. Shoot a strap holding a backpack, armor, or a similarly strapped-on item so that it falls off. Enabler.
